note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a LIT 18; A06b LIT 18; L05 LIT 24(2), 26(2)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another (with exceptions). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Lithuania, 2024
sources.said: Person has legally resided in Lithuania for the last 10 years and has the right of permanent residence. ... Renunciation or automatic loss of citizenship of another country. ... Person acquires citizenship of another country (there are exceptions). Person should inform Lithuania within 2 months of acquisition of citizenship of the other country).
